method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_code
tools.description:
Search indexed codebases in Milvus using natural language queries.

    You can optionally provide a search scope. When scope is provided, only the specified indexed collections/codebases will be searched.

    Use list_codebases first if you need to know which codebases are currently indexed.

query.description: Natural language query to search for in the indexed codebases

scope.description: Optional list of indexed codebase names to restrict the search scope

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: list_codebases
tools.description:
List the codebases that are currently indexed in Milvus.

    The result is determined from indexed collection names. Use this tool before search_code if you need to know valid scope values.

tools.name: search_doc
tools.description:
Search Horizon-related document snippets by natural language query, including manuals, guides, references, and relevant passages.
Use document library path `oe_doc` by default. Only provide `path` when you need to search a different library.
Optional `version` selects the OE documentation version to search (e.g. "3.10.0", "3.9.1"); omit it to use the default version (3.10.0).
Registered versions: 3.10.0, 3.9.1, 3.8.1, 3.7.1.1. Default: 3.10.0.
Do not provide `filters` unless you explicitly need constraints such as version.

path.description: Document library identifier. Defaults to oe_doc when omitted.

version.description: OE documentation version to search, e.g. "3.10.0". Defaults to 3.10.0 when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

filters.description: Optional filters such as version. Omit this field unless filtering is explicitly needed.

tools.name: list_oe_versions
tools.description: List the registered OE documentation versions available for search_doc/get_doc, newest first, including the default version.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description:
Get the full content overview of a required document by docId, typically after search_doc returns a docId and the user wants the full document.
Optional `version` must match the version used in the preceding search_doc call so the docId resolves within the same version's library.

version.description: OE documentation version the docId belongs to; must match the version used in the preceding search_doc call
